visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A group of tourists with umbrellas walks towards a large red gate of a traditional Japanese shrine (Tsurugaoka Hachimangu) under bright sunlight. (2) A green and yellow Enoden train pulls into a platform at a station in Kamakura. (3) The scene shifts to the exterior of a traditional Japanese restaurant with a blue noren curtain and stone steps. (4) Inside the restaurant, a sukiyaki pot with mushrooms and greens simmers on a portable gas stove near a window with a garden view. (5) Thinly sliced red raw beef is placed into the bubbling pot with metal tongs. (6) A hand uses chopsticks to dip a piece of cooked, marbled beef into a bowl of raw whisked egg. (7) A woman wearing a black shirt sits at a table, eating and reacting with a pleasant expression to the food. (8) A clear bottled beverage, labeled Shonan Cider, is poured into a glass filled with ice cubes. (9) A white dessert with yellow plum jam is shown in a decorative ceramic bowl. (10) Wide shots of the restaurant's interior featuring tatami mats and large windows looking out onto a lush, green manicured garden with woven lanterns.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 來到關東近郊的景點. [Slogan]: 鎌倉. [Logo]: @日本夾心稿. (2) [Subtitle]: 你們來鎌倉都吃什麼呢？ (3) [Subtitle]: 我這次探訪一間寧靜巷道中的日式餐廳. (4) [Subtitle]: 充滿日式風情的宅院，跟我一起進去看看吧. (5) [Subtitle]: 這間 Sasho 以涮涮鍋及壽喜燒為特色. (6) [Subtitle]: 噴香的壽喜燒午間套餐. (7) [Subtitle]: 來到鎌倉，一定要試試這裡最有名的「葉山牛」. (8) [Subtitle]: 夢幻級的葉山牛真的與眾不同，看看這油花分佈. (9) [Subtitle]: 裹上濃厚的蛋液. (10) [Subtitle]: 這真的超級美味，入口即化的軟嫩口感. (11) [Subtitle]: 真的太令人驚艷了. (12) [Subtitle]: 搭配上美味的湘南汽水，真是太滿足了. (13) [Subtitle]: 餐後甜點的梅醬冰淇淋也別有一番滋味. (14) [Subtitle]: 這裡不只餐點美味，環境也非常令人放鬆. (15) [Subtitle]: 被綠色庭園包圍，真的太幸福了. (16) [Subtitle]: 推薦大家有機會一定要來試試看.
